claim: When you first enable GuardDuty it runs completely independently of your AWS resources; only Runtime Monitoring with automatic agent deployment can add resource use and creates VPC endpoints.
question: Does enabling GuardDuty affect the performance of your workloads?

values.display: operates completely independent of your AWS resources

qualifiers.condition: Runtime Monitoring agent auto-deployment is the exception

evidence.quote: When you enable GuardDuty for the first time, it operates completely independent of your AWS resources. If you configure GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring to automatically deploy the GuardDuty security agent, this could result in additional resource utilization, and will also create VPC endpoints in VPCs used to run the monitored workloads.

claim: GuardDuty Malware Protection for S3 can be set up for S3 buckets even when base GuardDuty is not enabled for the account.
question: Do you need to enable GuardDuty to use Malware Protection for S3?

values.display: even when base GuardDuty is not enabled

evidence.quote: No, GuardDuty S3 Malware Protection gives you flexibility, allowing applications owners to set up Malware Protection for their S3 buckets even when base GuardDuty is not enabled for the account.

note: Malware Protection for S3 launched 2024 (see changes lens).
